    y = observation.get("player_y", 0)
    # Derive a simple robust policy that works across modes by:

    # Basic heuristic using optional cues
    dx = 0
    dy = 0

    # Prefer to move towards resource or opponent if cues exist
    target_dx = observation.get("target_dx", None)
    target_dy = observation.get("target_dy", None)

    if target_dx is not None and target_dy is not None:
        # Normalize to allowed move set
        if abs(target_dx) > 1:
            target_dx = 1 if target_dx > 0 else -1
        if abs(target_dy) > 1:
            target_dy = 1 if target_dy > 0 else -1
        dx = int(target_dx)
        dy = int(target_dy)
        return [dx, dy]

    # If no direct target cue, use generic exploration-lite policy
    mode = observation.get("mode", None)
    if mode == "resource_collection":
        # Try a small random-like deterministic pattern: prefer right then down
        dx, dy = 1, 0
        if observation.get("step", 0) % 2 == 0:
            dy = 1
        return [dx, dy]

    if mode == "pursuit_evasion":
        # If an evader is detected, move toward its last known position if provided
        ev_dx = observation.get("evader_dx", None)
        ev_dy = observation.get("evader_dy", None)
        if ev_dx is not None and ev_dy is not None:
            if abs(ev_dx) > 1:
                ev_dx = 1 if ev_dx > 0 else -1
            if abs(ev_dy) > 1:
                ev_dy = 1 if ev_dy > 0 else -1
            return [int(ev_dx), int(ev_dy)]
        # Otherwise keep a defensive small step
        return [0, 0]

    if mode == "territory_control":
        # Move to chase a border/control cue if provided
        border_dx = observation.get("border_dx", None)
        border_dy = observation.get("border_dy", None)
        if border_dx is not None and border_dy is not None:
            if abs(border_dx) > 1:
                border_dx = 1 if border_dx > 0 else -1
            if abs(border_dy) > 1:
                border_dy = 1 if border_dy > 0 else -1
            return [int(border_dx), int(border_dy)]
        # Default small advance
        return [0, 1]

    # Fallback: do not move
    return [0, 0]
